reading: Hundreds of people have taken part in a protest against plans to build a new data centre because of concerns about its effects on the area.
Placard-waving opponents highlight concerns about a data centre development on the local landscape.
Developers want to construct a complex on a 101-acre site between Caernarfon and Y Felinheli, in Gwynedd.
They claim it could create more than 900 roles during construction and 200 permanent roles.
About 300 gathered for a rally in Caernarfon to highlight their opposition.
More than 22,500 people have signed a petition opposing the plan.
Canolfan Ddata Menai has previously stated its proposals would "transform and revitalise the long-derelict" site and offer significant employment.
However, local opponent Ernest Dyson said the project represented "basically the destruction of the most beautiful part of the Menai Strait".
He further conveyed his incredulity, stating, "It is quite incredible it should come to this."
Liz Saville Roberts, the Plaid Cymru MP for Dwyfor Meirionnydd, commented that data centres must be "the right size, the right technology and in the right places."
She stressed the need for "proper regulations" and ensuring communities benefit from such developments.
Roberts highlighted Wales's "too long a history of extractive industries that left nothing behind and have little benefit for communities."
She asserted that this pattern "mustn't happen again in the 21st Century."
Canolfan Ddata Menai responded that the project would ensure "continued use" of the surrounding area, including Lôn Las Menai cycleway and footpath.
They also claimed it would have "no undue impact" on the Menai Strait and an associated Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI).

vocabulary.definition: Positions or jobs in an organization, often implying specific responsibilities and duties.
Expressed something clearly and explicitly, often in a formal manner.
Formal plans or suggestions put forward for consideration or discussion.
To make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of something.
To give new life, energy, or vigor to something, restoring it to a more active or healthy state.
Referring to a place or building that has been neglected and in a poor state for a significant, extended period.
Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention; notably large or meaningful.
The state of being unwilling or unable to believe something, often accompanied by a sense of surprise.
Industries that involve the removal of natural resources from the earth, such as mining, quarrying, or oil extraction.
An impact or effect that is excessive, disproportionate, or inappropriate in a given situation.

entries.ja: 組織における役職や仕事で、特定の責任や職務を伴うことが多いもの。
entries.ko: 조직 내의 직위나 업무를 의미하며, 종종 특정한 책임과 의무를 수반합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 组织中的职位或工作，通常包含特定的责任和职责。
entries.es: Puestos o empleos dentro de una organización, que a menudo implican responsabilidades y deberes específicos.
entries.pt-BR: Cargos ou empregos em uma organização, frequentemente implicando responsabilidades e deveres específicos.
entries.fr: Postes ou emplois au sein d'une organisation, impliquant souvent des responsabilités et des devoirs spécifiques.
entries.de: Positionen oder Arbeitsplätze in einer Organisation, die oft bestimmte Verantwortlichkeiten und Aufgaben mit sich bringen.

entries.ja: 何かを明確かつはっきりと、しばしば公式な形で述べたこと。
entries.ko: 무언가를 명확하고 분명하게, 종종 공식적인 방식으로 표현했습니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以明确、直接的方式表达某事，通常以正式的形式。
entries.es: Haber expresado algo de manera clara y explícita, a menudo de forma formal.
entries.pt-BR: Expressou algo de forma clara e explícita, frequentemente de maneira formal.
entries.fr: Avoir exprimé quelque chose de manière claire et explicite, souvent de façon formelle.
entries.de: Etwas klar und deutlich, oft in formeller Weise, zum Ausdruck gebracht haben.

entries.ja: 検討や議論のために提案される正式な計画や意見。
entries.ko: 고려하거나 논의하기 위해 제시되는 공식적인 계획이나 제안.
entries.zh-Hans: 为供考虑或讨论而提出的正式计划或建议。
entries.es: Planes o sugerencias formales que se presentan para su consideración o discusión.
entries.pt-BR: Planos ou sugestões formais apresentados para consideração ou discussão.
entries.fr: Plans ou suggestions formels présentés pour être examinés ou discutés.
entries.de: Formelle Pläne oder Vorschläge, die zur Prüfung oder Diskussion unterbreitet werden.

entries.ja: 何かの形、外観、または特性を徹底的かつ劇的に変えること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 형태, 외모 또는 특징을 철저하거나 극적으로 바꾸는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某物的形式、外观或特征进行彻底或戏剧性的改变。
entries.es: Hacer un cambio completo o drástico en la forma, apariencia o carácter de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer uma mudança completa ou dramática na forma, aparência ou caráter de algo.
entries.fr: Apporter un changement complet ou spectaculaire à la forme, à l'apparence ou au caractère de quelque chose.
entries.de: Eine gründliche oder dramatische Veränderung in der Form, dem Aussehen oder dem Charakter von etwas vornehmen.

entries.ja: 何かに新たな生命、エネルギー、活力を与え、より活動的または健康な状態に戻すこと。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 새로운 생명, 에너지 또는 활력을 불어넣어 더 활동적이거나 건강한 상태로 되돌리는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某物重获新生、能量或活力，使其恢复到更活跃或健康的状态。
entries.es: Dar nueva vida, energía o vigor a algo, restaurándolo a un estado más activo o saludable.
entries.pt-BR: Dar nova vida, energia ou vigor a algo, restaurando-o a um estado mais ativo ou saudável.
entries.fr: Redonner vie, énergie ou vigueur à quelque chose, le restaurant à un état plus actif ou sain.
entries.de: Etwas wieder mit neuem Leben, Energie oder Kraft erfüllen und es in einen aktiveren oder gesünderen Zustand zurückversetzen.

entries.ja: 長期間にわたって放置され、荒廃した状態にある場所や建物を指す言葉。
entries.ko: 상당히 오랜 기간 동안 방치되어 황폐한 상태에 있는 장소나 건물을 가리키는 말.
entries.zh-Hans: 指一个地方或建筑物已被忽视并在长期内处于破旧状态。
entries.es: Referente a un lugar o edificio que ha estado descuidado y en malas condiciones durante un período prolongado y significativo.
entries.pt-BR: Referente a um lugar ou edifício que foi negligenciado e está em mau estado por um período significativo e prolongado.
entries.fr: Se réfère à un lieu ou un bâtiment qui a été négligé et en mauvais état pendant une période significative et prolongée.
entries.de: Bezieht sich auf einen Ort oder ein Gebäude, das über einen erheblichen, längeren Zeitraum vernachlässigt und in einem schlechten Zustand war.

entries.ja: 注目に値するほど重要であるか、または十分に大きいこと。特に大きいか意味があること。
entries.ko: 주목할 가치가 있을 만큼 충분히 크거나 중요한 것. 특히 크거나 의미 있는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 足够大或足够重要，值得关注；尤其庞大或有意义的。
entries.es: Suficientemente grande o importante como para ser digno de atención; notablemente grande o significativo.
entries.pt-BR: Suficientemente grande ou importante para ser digno de atenção; notavelmente grande ou significativo.
entries.fr: Suffisamment grand ou important pour être digne d'attention ; notablement grand ou significatif.
entries.de: Ausreichend groß oder wichtig, um beachtenswert zu sein; bemerkenswert groß oder bedeutsam.

entries.ja: 何かを信じようとしない、または信じることができない状態。しばしば驚きの感覚を伴う。
entries.ko: 무언가를 믿고 싶지 않거나 믿을 수 없는 상태로, 종종 놀라움을 동반합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 不愿或无法相信某事的状态，通常伴随着一种惊讶感。
entries.es: El estado de no estar dispuesto o ser incapaz de creer algo, a menudo acompañado de una sensación de sorpresa.
entries.pt-BR: O estado de não querer ou não conseguir acreditar em algo, frequentemente acompanhado por uma sensação de surpresa.
entries.fr: L'état de ne pas vouloir ou de ne pas pouvoir croire quelque chose, souvent accompagné d'un sentiment de surprise.
entries.de: Der Zustand, etwas nicht glauben zu wollen oder zu können, oft begleitet von einem Gefühl der Überraschung.

entries.ja: 鉱業、採石業、石油採掘など、地球から天然資源を採取することを伴う産業。
entries.ko: 광업, 채석업, 석유 추출과 같이 지구에서 천연자원을 제거하는 것을 포함하는 산업.
entries.zh-Hans: 涉及从地球中提取自然资源的工业，例如采矿、采石或石油开采。
entries.es: Industrias que implican la extracción de recursos naturales de la tierra, como la minería, la cantería o la extracción de petróleo.
entries.pt-BR: Indústrias que envolvem a remoção de recursos naturais da terra, como mineração, extração de pedras ou extração de petróleo.
entries.fr: Industries qui impliquent l'extraction de ressources naturelles de la terre, telles que l'exploitation minière, l'extraction de carrières ou l'extraction de pétrole.
entries.de: Industrien, die die Gewinnung natürlicher Ressourcen aus der Erde umfassen, wie Bergbau, Steinbruch oder Ölexploration.

entries.ja: ある状況において過度で、不釣り合いな、または不適切な影響や効果。
entries.ko: 특정 상황에서 과도하거나 불균형적이거나 부적절한 영향 또는 효과.
entries.zh-Hans: 在特定情况下，过于、不相称或不恰当的影响或效应。
entries.es: Un impacto o efecto que es excesivo, desproporcionado o inapropiado en una situación dada.
entries.pt-BR: Um impacto ou efeito que é excessivo, desproporcional ou inadequado em uma dada situação.
entries.fr: Un impact ou un effet qui est excessif, disproportionné ou inapproprié dans une situation donnée.
entries.de: Eine Auswirkung oder ein Effekt, der in einer gegebenen Situation übermäßig, unverhältnismäßig oder unangemessen ist.
